instruction: ARTBOOK FIRST remains the production gate. Company-wide final artbook submission is capped at one combined artbook per day. For the selected game of the day, planning owns story/world/causality, graphics owns character/monster/boss/environment/UI/intro concepts, development owns implementation structure and playable-demo architecture, QA owns player-flow/problem-scene/test evidence, and balance owns progression/combat feel/reward/difficulty. Departments collaborate and exchange evidence but do not author each other's sections. The director/ChatGPT may only assemble and summarize the five submitted sections into the single daily artbook and may not invent missing content. Each game must receive one initial combined artbook containing all five department sections before formal production progression. Existing Web games and daechung-rpg code/builds are prototype evidence. Current direct homepage artbook exposure remains daechung-rpg only; other games remain in collapsed/expandable pre-production listing until separately approved. Artbooks remain game-specific and follow artbook-style-profiles.json; uniform templates are forbidden. Story causality is the highest quality gate. Never modify web-games source files and never use paid automation or paid runners.
